allocation_policy: Existing rank_statistics.timing_callback unchanged: supplied-output reset inside call, output allocation and destruction timed; fixture setup/import/IPC/validation outside timers.
process_policy: Three ordinary-name worker prefixes, each native prefix exactlyone actual_core; serial seeded triads. No private/renamed modules admitted.
product_envelope: Root supplies independently qualified source/product artifacts containing product.json (exact files_sha256/schema/revision/profile), qualification.json, runtime.json (ci-offline-measurement-v1), runtime-lock.txt, wheels/, source.zip and byte-exact extracted source/. Accepted root pins bind full envelope, qualification, wheel, sourceZIP per role/profile. Phase1 null pins reject all native products.
barrier_policy: All3 successful native preparation receipts must match currentGHA runID/attempt/contract, bothmodes andworkers1/4; unique receiptIDs; fresh output+exclusiveclaim. Reference-only receipts never qualify.
exclusions: All995 original source cases and existing8readonly error fixtures remain untimed; no additional timing exclusions.
Private/prototype cores, failed65c product and unqualified before/after artifacts are rejected.
external_experiment: Native modes require --experiment and its exact rawSHA. External schema rank-statistics-experiment-v1 binds template_sha256 (canonicalLF) and accepted_products before/after xall3 profiles; each pin has revision, four artifact/source/wheel/qualificationSHA values, artifact_run/name, and explicit equal scope(image_paths,metadata_paths,sdk_families,sdk_members,sdk_family_names). Tracked null pins stay unchanged. No self-referential product/source hashes.
startup_authentication: One-use source/run/profile/role-bound secret over inherited stdio, with secret hashes/controller/source bound into exclusive measurement claim. Exact direct or one-hop declared Popen venv launcher only; no arbitrary ancestor trust. Probe mode is metadata-only/native0 and cannot satisfy native/preparation barriers.
validation_order: Complete untimed1379+4alias worker1/4 validation finishes serially in all3 workers before any one-worker warm/calibration/timing; fresh measurement host has no concurrent builds/correctness tests.

build_identity.qualification_binding: Original successful qualification records bind build-identity.json and all build-identity-evidence files before product pins are admitted.
build_identity.common_inputs: Actual compiler/backend/linker and executed LTO binaries, toolset/CRT/configuration, expanded per-TU/link argv, used headers and external link inputs. Normalize only declared SOURCE/BUILD prefixes.
build_identity.source_scope: Exclude src/rank.cpp source content only from common identity; unchanged exact approved three-file source/patch guard remains mandatory.
build_identity.generated_outputs: Retain every raw object/archive/core output hash per product. Traceable outputs may contain nonreproducible LTO stamps, so their bytes are not common inputs; external NumPy/pybind/build-env libraries are never blanket-excluded.
build_identity.producer_integration: Future genuine qualification-host capture required; no retroactive facts or pins for existing186 products.
